text:
🎬 Three steps to make product ads on Lovart

1. Drop your shot: any product photo, even a casual phone snap
2. Storyboard: select Storyboard Skill, attach the photo, generate with GPT-Image 2.0
3. Cinematic video: bring it to life with Seedance 2.0

Full prompt below ↓ https://t.co/XlOiioz93r
content: Use Seedance 2.0 to turn a storyboard (generated from a product photo) into a cinematic product ad video.

thread_texts: Try the prompt on https://t.co/fcEGoAE8VX https://t.co/OPD688DZqt
